title: You’re Always Seeing the Past
hook: What if the Sun simply switched off right this second?
script: What if the Sun simply switched off right this second? The light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach you. If a solar flare occurred, you'd only know about it after that delay. In that time, light travels 93 million miles, circling the Earth 7.5 times. But here's the even wilder part: every time you look at the Sun, it's actually eight minutes and twenty seconds in the past. This means you're never witnessing its current state.

captions: Are you seeing the past in sunlight? Yes or no?
What would happen if the Sun turned off?
Reality is stranger than it seems.
